entities.summary: Antoni "Toni" Comín i Oliveres is a Catalan intellectual and politician from Spain. He is currently the executive vice-president of the Council for the Republic and has been an MEP since July 2019. He is the fourth child of the politician and intellectual Alfonso Carlos Comín i Ros and Maria Lluïsa Oliveres i Sanvicens, whose other children are Maria, Pere and Betona. He is the partner of the stage designer Sergi Corbera, and they have a daughter called Laia. Antoni Comín was a writers & intellectuals from Barcelona (b. 1971-03-07, Barcelona). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
